reviewedPartitionRationales.crossroads: The west edge includes the authored west hedge and Mistfen cue without claiming the marsh basin; the north edge includes the castle-gate approach and festival road; the east edge includes the Coast and Wildwood cues; the south edge closes below the plaza and market staging. The 32px-aligned bounds were reviewed against those geographic landmarks. Their equality to the snapped fragment envelope is coincidental and is not used as a derivation rule.
